title_zh: v203-v204：九相机救回全部五相机失败，但当前调用余量仍依赖稠密表示
title_en: v203-v204: nine cameras rescue every five-camera failure, but current call headroom still depends on a dense representation
scope_zh: 仅限历史上已经暴露的 p14 开发轨迹、13 套标定和封存的五/九相机结果；不是 fresh、blind、validation 或 test。
scope_en: Limited to the historically exposed p14 development trajectory, 13 calibrations, and sealed five/all-nine-camera results; this is not fresh, blind, validation, or test evidence.
interpretation_zh: 四个额外视角消除了全部 24 个被审计的五相机失败；在完整 1313 单元上，九相机 full-DCT K1 已与 K2 一样通过全部严格门，并少用 1 次 A 和 1 次 A^T。可是 Zero、BP-CGLS1、Zero-CGLS K2 和 affine Jacobi-PCGLS1 均为 0/1313，说明当前余量来自稠密 full-DCT 表示，而不是任意便宜经典迭代。
interpretation_en: Four additional views remove all 24 audited five-camera failures. Across all 1,313 cells, all-nine full-DCT K1 clears every strict gate like K2 while using one fewer A and one fewer AT. Zero, BP-CGLS1, Zero-CGLS K2, and affine Jacobi-PCGLS1 each reach 0/1,313, so the current headroom comes from the dense full-DCT representation rather than any cheap classical iteration.
decision_boundary_zh: full-DCT K1 继承稠密几何缓存和特征路径；本轮没有 fresh wall/RSS，也没有独立公开工况或真实 BOST。因此只能称历史已暴露开发条件下的表示/调用数余量，不能称部署算法、速度提升或算法突破。
decision_boundary_en: Full-DCT K1 inherits a dense geometry cache and feature path. This run contains no fresh wall/RSS evidence, independent public condition, or real BOST. It therefore establishes representation/call-count headroom only on an exposed development condition, not a deployable algorithm, speedup, or algorithmic breakthrough.
next_scientific_gate_zh: 结果前只冻结一个最小的稠密缓存移除门：用部署可见观测和报告几何产生紧凑、相机置换等变且支持可变相机数的表示，在保持九相机 K1 全轨迹门的同时接受五/七/九/十二相机；先跑便宜 CPU 对照和独立复算，不上大模型或 GPU。
next_scientific_gate_en: Preregister one minimal dense-cache-removal gate: derive a compact, camera-permutation-equivariant, variable-cardinality representation from deployment-visible observations and reported geometry while preserving the all-nine K1 complete-trajectory gate and supporting 5/7/9/12 cameras. Run cheap CPU controls and independent recomputation first; do not use a large model or GPU.
